title: REQ · Run takes the per-World lock, runs the agent in an isolated worktree under a timeout
summary: Run acquires the lock, returns a locked error when held, creates a worktree, applies a context timeout
description: Context: lock.Acquire returns an error wrapping lock.ErrLocked when the lock file exists. Desired behavior: Run acquires cfg.LockPath first, persists a RUNNING execution, creates a worktree under WorkRoot/<id>, runs the agent with context.WithTimeout(cfg.Timeout), then removes the worktree on completion or failure. Expected result: a held lock yields a locked error with no side effects. Why: one execution per World and isolation from production files.
acceptance_criteria: Given the lock file already exists, when Run is called, then the returned error satisfies errors.Is(err, lock.ErrLocked) and Worktrees.Create is never called
Given a successful agent, when Run returns, then the lock file no longer exists and Worktrees.Remove was called with the worktree directory
Given an agent that waits for ctx.Done and Timeout 20ms, when Run is called, then the error satisfies errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) and the stored status is FAILED

in_scope: runner.go with types, New and Run

definition_of_done: Run locks, isolates and times out as specified
